explanation_source: Kondisi ban berisiko harus dinilai sebelum kendaraan diserahkan.
explanation_english: A potentially dangerous tire condition must be assessed before returning the vehicle.

lesson_title_source: Ban, roda, dan tanda gangguan rem
lesson_title_english: Tires, Wheels, and Signs of Brake Problems
prompt_source: Dalam alur «Ban, roda, dan tanda gangguan rem», setelah langkah pertama selesai, apa langkah berikutnya?
prompt_english: In the “Tires, wheels, and signs of brake trouble” workflow, what is the next step after the first one?
explanation_source: Urutan yang diajarkan: Cocokkan roda dengan butir pemeriksaan → Periksa visual ban, pelek, dan area rem → Ukur hanya bagian yang ditugaskan dengan alat sesuai → Catat kelainan dan minta teknisi menilai.
explanation_english: Sequence taught: Match the wheel to the inspection item → Visually inspect the tire, rim, and brake area → Measure only the assigned parts with the appropriate tool → Record abnormalities and ask a technician to assess them.

prompt_source: Uap terlihat dekat tutup pendingin. Apa tindakan tepat?
prompt_english: Steam is visible near the radiator cap. What should you do?
explanation_source: Bagian panas perlu ditangani sesuai prosedur aman dan arahan penanggung jawab.
explanation_english: Hot components must be handled according to safety procedures and the supervisor's instructions.

prompt_source: Dalam alur «Oli, pendingin, dan baterai», setelah langkah pertama selesai, apa langkah berikutnya?
prompt_english: In the “Oil, coolant, and battery” workflow, what is the next step after the first one?
explanation_source: Urutan yang diajarkan: Pastikan kondisi mesin aman dan gunakan APD → Kenali titik pemeriksaan pada manual → Periksa level dan keadaan luar tanpa membuka bagian berbahaya → Catat kebocoran atau panas dan laporkan.
explanation_english: Sequence taught: Make sure the engine is safe to inspect and wear PPE → Locate inspection points in the manual → Check fluid levels and external condition without opening hazardous components → Record and report leaks or heat.

lesson_title_source: Memilih alat ukur dan mencatat hasil
lesson_title_english: Choosing Measuring Tools and Recording Results
prompt_source: Apa yang perlu cocok sebelum membandingkan hasil ukur?
prompt_english: What must match before comparing measurement results?
explanation_source: Hasil dapat dibandingkan jika alat dan kondisi pengukuran sesuai.
explanation_english: Results can be compared when the tools and measurement conditions are appropriate.

lesson_title_source: Memilih alat ukur dan mencatat hasil
lesson_title_english: Choosing Measuring Tools and Recording Results
prompt_source: Angka multimeter berubah-ubah. Apa yang dilakukan?
prompt_english: The multimeter reading keeps changing. What should you do?
explanation_source: Pengukuran tidak stabil tidak dapat dipercaya sampai alat atau metodenya diverifikasi.
explanation_english: An unstable measurement cannot be trusted until the tool or method has been verified.

lesson_title_source: Memilih alat ukur dan mencatat hasil
lesson_title_english: Choosing Measuring Tools and Recording Results
prompt_source: Dalam alur «Memilih alat ukur dan mencatat hasil», setelah langkah pertama selesai, apa langkah berikutnya?
prompt_english: In the “Selecting measuring tools and recording results” workflow, what is the next step after the first one?
explanation_source: Urutan yang diajarkan: Tentukan jenis pengukuran dari perintah kerja → Pilih alat dengan rentang dan satuan sesuai → Periksa alat dan ukur pada titik yang ditentukan → Catat nilai dan minta verifikasi jika meragukan.
explanation_english: Sequence taught: Determine the measurement needed from the work order → Select a tool with the appropriate range and units → Check the tool and measure at the specified point → Record the value and request verification if it seems doubtful.

prompt_source: Kapan pekerja boleh berada di bawah kendaraan terangkat?
prompt_english: When may a worker go underneath a raised vehicle?
explanation_source: Pengaman dan kestabilan harus dipastikan sebelum berada di bawah kendaraan.
explanation_english: Confirm that the safety locks are engaged and the vehicle is stable before going underneath it.

prompt_source: Titik angkat belum jelas dan rekan akan masuk ke bawah kendaraan. Apa yang tepat?
prompt_english: The lifting points are unclear, and a coworker is about to go under the vehicle. What should you do?
explanation_source: Area diamankan dan titik angkat harus diketahui sebelum pengangkatan.
explanation_english: Secure the area and identify the lifting points before raising the vehicle.

prompt_source: Dalam alur «Mengangkat kendaraan dengan aman», setelah langkah pertama selesai, apa langkah berikutnya?
prompt_english: In the “Safely raising a vehicle” workflow, what is the next step after the first one?
explanation_source: Urutan yang diajarkan: Cocokkan titik tumpu dengan manual → Periksa lift dan kosongkan area → Posisikan alat serta pengaman roda sesuai prosedur → Angkat, kunci, dan pastikan aman sebelum bekerja.
explanation_english: Sequence taught: Match the support points to the manual → Inspect the lift and clear the area → Position the equipment and wheel chocks according to procedure → Raise and lock the vehicle, then confirm it is secure before working.

prompt_source: Mengapa kendaraan yang tampak mati tetap harus diperlakukan sebagai bertegangan tinggi?
prompt_english: Why should a vehicle that appears to be off still be treated as a high-voltage hazard?
explanation_source: Sistem dapat menyimpan energi sehingga perlu isolasi dan petugas berwenang.
explanation_english: The system may retain stored energy, so isolation and authorized personnel are required.

prompt_source: Kabel bertegangan tinggi rusak dan Anda belum dilatih. Apa tindakan tepat?
prompt_english: A high-voltage cable is damaged, and you have not been trained. What should you do?
explanation_source: Kabel rusak berisiko sengatan atau kebakaran dan harus ditangani ahli.
explanation_english: A damaged cable can cause electric shock or fire and must be handled by a qualified technician.

prompt_source: Dalam alur «Kendaraan hibrida dan tegangan tinggi», setelah langkah pertama selesai, apa langkah berikutnya?
prompt_english: In the “Hybrid vehicles and high voltage” workflow, what is the next step after the first one?
explanation_source: Urutan yang diajarkan: Identifikasi kendaraan dan tanda tegangan tinggi → Cocokkan tugas dengan pelatihan dan otorisasi → Amankan area dan ikuti prosedur isolasi yang disetujui → Hentikan serta laporkan kabel atau baterai yang rusak.
explanation_english: Sequence taught: Identify the vehicle and high-voltage markings → Confirm the task matches your training and authorization → Secure the area and follow the approved isolation procedure → Stop and report damaged cables or batteries.

prompt_source: Baut tertukar dan nilai torsi belum tersedia. Apa tindakan tepat?
prompt_english: Bolts have been mixed up, and the torque value is not available. What should you do?
explanation_source: Identitas dan nilai harus dipastikan sebelum pemasangan.
explanation_english: Confirm the component identity and required value before installation.

prompt_source: Dalam alur «Membongkar dan memasang komponen», setelah langkah pertama selesai, apa langkah berikutnya?
prompt_english: In the “Removing and installing components” workflow, what is the next step after the first one?
explanation_source: Urutan yang diajarkan: Baca urutan dan nilai pada manual → Tandai posisi serta simpan komponen berlabel → Pasang dengan alat dan spesifikasi tepat → Hitung komponen dan minta verifikasi.
explanation_english: Sequence taught: Read the sequence and values in the manual → Mark positions and store labeled components → Install using the correct tools and specifications → Count the components and request verification.

prompt_source: Kapan uji jalan boleh dilakukan?
prompt_english: When may a road test be performed?
explanation_source: Uji jalan memerlukan otorisasi, izin mengemudi, dan kondisi aman.
explanation_english: A road test requires authorization, a valid driver's license, and safe conditions.

prompt_source: Lampu peringatan belum diperiksa dan Anda diminta uji jalan. Apa respons tepat?
prompt_english: A warning light has not been checked, and you are asked to road-test the vehicle. How should you respond?
explanation_source: Pemeriksaan belum lengkap dan uji jalan di luar kewenangan tidak boleh dilakukan.
explanation_english: The inspection is incomplete, and you must not perform a road test without authorization.

prompt_source: Dalam alur «Pemeriksaan akhir dan uji fungsi», setelah langkah pertama selesai, apa langkah berikutnya?
prompt_english: In the “Final inspection and function test” workflow, what is the next step after the first one?
explanation_source: Urutan yang diajarkan: Cocokkan daftar kerja dengan pekerjaan → Periksa alat dan area terkait → Lakukan uji fungsi yang ditugaskan sesuai prosedur → Catat hasil dan minta pemeriksaan akhir.
explanation_english: Sequence taught: Match the work order to the work performed → Check the tools and related area → Carry out the assigned function test according to procedure → Record the results and request a final inspection.

lesson_title_english: Holding a Vehicle and Reporting Abnormalities
prompt_source: Apa yang membuat laporan anomali dapat ditindaklanjuti?
prompt_english: What makes an abnormality report actionable?
explanation_source: Rincian yang diamati membantu pemeriksaan dan penelusuran.
explanation_english: Observed details support inspection and traceability.

lesson_title_english: Holding a Vehicle and Reporting Abnormalities
prompt_source: Bunyi baru muncul setelah perbaikan dan pelanggan akan mengambil mobil. Apa tindakan tepat?
prompt_english: A new sound appeared after a repair, and the customer is about to collect the car. What should you do?
explanation_source: Bunyi baru perlu diperiksa sebelum kendaraan dikembalikan.
explanation_english: A new sound must be inspected before returning the vehicle.

lesson_title_english: Holding a Vehicle and Reporting Abnormalities
prompt_source: Dalam alur «Menahan kendaraan dan melaporkan anomali», setelah langkah pertama selesai, apa langkah berikutnya?
prompt_english: In the “Holding a vehicle and reporting an abnormality” workflow, what is the next step after the first one?
explanation_source: Urutan yang diajarkan: Hentikan tahap berisiko dan amankan kendaraan → Beri tanda tahan menurut prosedur → Catat fakta, lokasi, waktu, dan tindakan sementara → Laporkan dan tunggu keputusan penanggung jawab.
explanation_english: Sequence taught: Stop the risky work and secure the vehicle → Mark it as held according to procedure → Record the facts, location, time, and temporary action → Report the issue and wait for the supervisor's decision.

lesson_title_source: Catatan servis, suku cadang, dan penjelasan
prompt_source: Mengapa nomor dan jumlah suku cadang dicatat?
prompt_english: Why should part numbers and quantities be recorded?
explanation_source: Catatan suku cadang mendukung penelusuran dan penjelasan servis.
explanation_english: Parts records support traceability and service explanations.

lesson_title_source: Catatan servis, suku cadang, dan penjelasan
prompt_source: Pelanggan meminta foto catatan dan biaya yang belum disetujui. Apa tindakan tepat?
prompt_english: A customer asks for a photo of the records and an estimate that has not been approved. What should you do?
explanation_source: Data pelanggan dilindungi dan informasi belum disahkan dijelaskan petugas berwenang.
explanation_english: Customer data must be protected, and only authorized staff should explain information that has not been approved.

lesson_title_source: Catatan servis, suku cadang, dan penjelasan
prompt_source: Dalam alur «Catatan servis, suku cadang, dan penjelasan», setelah langkah pertama selesai, apa langkah berikutnya?
prompt_english: In the “Service records, parts, and explanations” workflow, what is the next step after the first one?
explanation_source: Urutan yang diajarkan: Cocokkan catatan dengan kendaraan dan perintah kerja → Catat komponen, jumlah, hasil, dan bagian terbuka → Pisahkan suku cadang serta dokumen menurut prosedur → Serahkan catatan dan arahkan pertanyaan pelanggan.
explanation_english: Sequence taught: Match records to the vehicle and work order → Record parts, quantities, results, and unresolved items → Sort parts and documents according to procedure → Hand over the records and direct customer questions to the appropriate staff.

lesson_title_english: Safety Briefings and Foreign Object Debris
prompt_source: Ada potongan logam dekat jalur kendaraan. Apa tindakan tepat?
prompt_english: A piece of metal is near a vehicle route. What should you do?
explanation_source: Area harus dikomunikasikan dan diamankan sebelum operasi berlanjut.
explanation_english: Communicate about the area and secure it before resuming operations.

lesson_title_english: Safety Briefings and Foreign Object Debris
prompt_source: Dalam alur «Briefing keselamatan dan benda asing», setelah langkah pertama selesai, apa langkah berikutnya?
prompt_english: In the “Safety briefing and foreign objects” workflow, what is the next step after the first one?
explanation_source: Urutan yang diajarkan: Hadiri briefing dan ulangi instruksi penting → Pakai APD serta periksa kondisinya → Periksa area kerja untuk benda asing dan bahaya → Hentikan pekerjaan sekitar temuan dan laporkan.
explanation_english: Sequence taught: Attend the briefing and repeat key instructions → Wear PPE and check its condition → Inspect the work area for foreign objects and hazards → Stop work near any finding and report it.

prompt_source: Siapa yang boleh memberi isyarat dalam pergerakan pesawat?
prompt_english: Who may signal during aircraft movement?
explanation_source: Gerakan pesawat harus dikendalikan petugas berwenang.
explanation_english: Aircraft movement must be controlled by authorized personnel.

prompt_source: Pandangan terhadap pemandu hilang dan radio tidak terdengar. Apa yang tepat?
prompt_english: You lose sight of the guide and cannot hear the radio. What should you do?
explanation_source: Kehilangan komunikasi berarti operasi perlu dihentikan dan dikonfirmasi ulang.
explanation_english: If communication is lost, stop the operation and confirm the instructions again.

prompt_source: Dalam alur «Dukungan pergerakan pesawat di darat», setelah langkah pertama selesai, apa langkah berikutnya?
prompt_english: In the “Ground movement support for aircraft” workflow, what is the next step after the first one?
explanation_source: Urutan yang diajarkan: Periksa izin masuk, rute, dan pemimpin pergerakan → Pastikan komunikasi serta posisi petugas → Lakukan tugas dengan isyarat dan alat yang disetujui → Hentikan gerakan bila komunikasi terputus.
explanation_english: Sequence taught: Check entry authorization, route, and movement lead → Confirm communication and staff positions → Perform the task using approved signals and equipment → Stop movement if communication is lost.

prompt_source: Apa yang harus diperiksa sebelum kendaraan layanan darat dipakai?
prompt_english: What should be checked before using ground-service vehicles?
explanation_source: Keselamatan bergantung pada izin, kondisi teknis, lingkungan, dan rute.
explanation_english: Safety depends on authorization, equipment condition, the environment, and the route.

prompt_source: Rem kendaraan penarik bermasalah saat apron licin. Apa tindakan tepat?
prompt_english: A tow vehicle's brakes are not working properly on a slippery apron. What should you do?
explanation_source: Kendaraan bermasalah tidak boleh digunakan, terutama pada permukaan licin.
explanation_english: Do not use a vehicle with a fault, especially on a slippery surface.

prompt_source: Dalam alur «Peralatan layanan darat dan cuaca», setelah langkah pertama selesai, apa langkah berikutnya?
prompt_english: In the “Ground-service equipment and weather” workflow, what is the next step after the first one?
explanation_source: Urutan yang diajarkan: Periksa izin operator dan alat → Nilai cuaca, permukaan, serta jalur → Gunakan peralatan sesuai batas dan instruksi → Amankan alat dan laporkan perubahan atau kerusakan.
explanation_english: Sequence taught: Check operator authorization and equipment → Assess the weather, surface, and route → Use equipment within its limits and according to instructions → Secure equipment and report changes or damage.

lesson_title_source: Menyortir bagasi menurut label dan tujuan
lesson_title_english: Sorting Baggage by Label and Destination
prompt_source: Mengapa bagasi tanpa label terbaca harus dipisahkan?
prompt_english: Why should baggage with an unreadable label be separated?
explanation_source: Identitas tidak jelas meningkatkan risiko salah muat sehingga perlu ditelusuri.
explanation_english: Unclear identification increases the risk of loading an item onto the wrong flight, so it must be traced.

lesson_title_source: Menyortir bagasi menurut label dan tujuan
lesson_title_english: Sorting Baggage by Label and Destination
prompt_source: Tujuan bagasi tidak terbaca dan troli lain hampir penuh. Apa tindakan tepat?
prompt_english: The baggage destination is unreadable, and another cart is nearly full. What should you do?
explanation_source: Jangan menebak tujuan; bagasi ditahan sampai identitasnya dikonfirmasi.
explanation_english: Do not guess the destination; hold the baggage until its identity is confirmed.

lesson_title_source: Menyortir bagasi menurut label dan tujuan
lesson_title_english: Sorting Baggage by Label and Destination
prompt_source: Dalam alur «Menyortir bagasi menurut label dan tujuan», setelah langkah pertama selesai, apa langkah berikutnya?
prompt_english: In the “Sorting baggage by label and destination” workflow, what is the next step after the first one?
explanation_source: Urutan yang diajarkan: Baca label dan instruksi khusus → Cocokkan penerbangan serta tujuan pada sistem → Tempatkan bagasi pada jalur yang benar → Tahan bagasi tanpa identitas dan minta verifikasi.
explanation_english: Sequence taught: Read the label and special instructions → Match the flight and destination in the system → Place the baggage on the correct route → Hold any baggage without identification and request verification.

prompt_source: Label kargo berbeda dan posisi tidak cocok. Apa tindakan tepat?
prompt_english: The cargo label is different, and the position does not match. What should you do?
explanation_source: Perbedaan dokumen atau posisi harus diselesaikan sebelum pemuatan.
explanation_english: Differences in documents or position must be resolved before loading.

prompt_source: Dalam alur «Menangani dan memuat kargo», setelah langkah pertama selesai, apa langkah berikutnya?
prompt_english: In the “Handling and loading cargo” workflow, what is the next step after the first one?
explanation_source: Urutan yang diajarkan: Cocokkan kargo dengan daftar dan tanda penanganan → Periksa kemasan serta alat pemindah → Pindahkan dan muat sesuai rencana yang disahkan → Konfirmasi penguncian dan laporkan perbedaan.
explanation_english: Sequence taught: Match cargo to the list and handling labels → Check the packaging and moving equipment → Move and load according to the approved plan → Confirm restraints are secured and report any discrepancies.

lesson_title_source: Pemeriksaan barang rusak atau salah rute
prompt_source: Apa informasi penting dalam laporan barang bermasalah?
prompt_english: What key information belongs in a report about a problem item?
explanation_source: Rincian mendukung penelusuran dan tindak lanjut.
explanation_english: Details support traceability and follow-up.

lesson_title_source: Pemeriksaan barang rusak atau salah rute
prompt_source: Koper bocor dan berbeda penerbangan dari troli. Apa respons tepat?
prompt_english: A suitcase is leaking and is for a different flight from the other items on the cart. How should you respond?
explanation_source: Kebocoran dan identitas berbeda perlu dipisahkan dan diperiksa.
explanation_english: A leaking item with mismatched identification must be separated and inspected.

lesson_title_source: Pemeriksaan barang rusak atau salah rute
prompt_source: Dalam alur «Pemeriksaan barang rusak atau salah rute», setelah langkah pertama selesai, apa langkah berikutnya?
prompt_english: In the “Inspecting damaged or misrouted items” workflow, what is the next step after the first one?
explanation_source: Urutan yang diajarkan: Cocokkan jumlah dan identitas saat menerima → Periksa kondisi sebelum dipindahkan → Pisahkan barang bermasalah dan tandai → Laporkan fakta serta teruskan status kepada pengawas.
explanation_english: Sequence taught: Match the quantity and identification on receipt → Check the item's condition before moving it → Separate and mark any problem item → Report the facts and pass its status to a supervisor.

prompt_source: Informasi apa yang aman diberikan kepada penumpang?
prompt_english: What information is safe to provide to a passenger?
explanation_source: Gunakan informasi resmi yang sudah dikonfirmasi.
explanation_english: Use official information that has been confirmed.

prompt_source: Status boarding belum diperbarui. Apa tindakan tepat?
prompt_english: The boarding status has not been updated. What should you do?
explanation_source: Petugas gerbang dapat memberi status yang sah dan bantuan tindak lanjut.
explanation_english: Gate staff can provide the official status and follow-up assistance.

prompt_source: Dalam alur «Penanganan penumpang dan informasi penerbangan», setelah langkah pertama selesai, apa langkah berikutnya?
prompt_english: In the “Passenger assistance and flight information” workflow, what is the next step after the first one?
explanation_source: Urutan yang diajarkan: Tanyakan kebutuhan dengan sopan → Periksa informasi pada sumber resmi → Berikan jawaban singkat yang terkonfirmasi → Serahkan permintaan khusus dan pastikan diterima.
explanation_english: Sequence taught: Ask politely what the passenger needs → Check information using an official source → Give a brief, confirmed answer → Pass on special requests and confirm they were received.

prompt_source: Apa yang perlu dipastikan sebelum troli makanan dimuat?
prompt_english: What must be checked before loading a food cart?
explanation_source: Identitas, kebersihan, dan kondisi troli melindungi layanan serta keselamatan.
explanation_english: Cart identification, cleanliness, and condition protect both service and safety.

prompt_source: Segel troli rusak dan jumlah berbeda. Apa tindakan tepat?
prompt_english: The food cart seal is broken, and the quantity does not match. What should you do?
explanation_source: Perbedaan perlu diklarifikasi oleh petugas berwenang sebelum pemuatan.
explanation_english: An authorized staff member must clarify any discrepancy before loading.

prompt_source: Dalam alur «Transportasi dan pemuatan makanan pesawat», setelah langkah pertama selesai, apa langkah berikutnya?
prompt_english: In the “Transporting and loading aircraft meals” workflow, what is the next step after the first one?
explanation_source: Urutan yang diajarkan: Cocokkan penerbangan dan jumlah troli → Periksa kebersihan, segel, roda, dan pengunci → Angkut serta muat melalui rute yang disetujui → Pastikan penguncian dan laporkan selisih.
explanation_english: Sequence taught: Match the flight and cart quantity → Check cleanliness, seals, wheels, and locks → Transport and load using the approved route → Confirm the locks and report any discrepancy.

prompt_source: Ada bau bahan bakar dan cairan dekat selang. Apa yang dilakukan?
prompt_english: There is a smell of fuel and liquid near a hose. What should you do?
explanation_source: Jangan sentuh atau mendekati tumpahan; jauhi dan panggil petugas khusus.
explanation_english: Do not touch or approach the spill; move away and call the specialist team.

prompt_source: Dalam alur «Batas aman penanganan bahan bakar», setelah langkah pertama selesai, apa langkah berikutnya?
prompt_english: In the “Safe limits for fuel handling” workflow, what is the next step after the first one?
explanation_source: Urutan yang diajarkan: Kenali zona dan pastikan peran serta otorisasi → Jaga jarak dan patuhi larangan sumber api → Menjauh sesuai instruksi bila ada kebocoran → Laporkan lokasi dan tanda bahaya ke petugas khusus.
explanation_english: Sequence taught: Identify the zone and confirm roles and authorization → Keep your distance and observe no-ignition rules → Move away as directed if there is a leak → Report the location and hazard signs to the specialist team.

prompt_source: Apa yang harus cocok sebelum perawatan dimulai?
prompt_english: What must be matched before maintenance begins?
explanation_source: Keterlacakan memerlukan dokumen dan komponen yang benar serta kewenangan.
explanation_english: Traceability requires the correct documents and components and proper authorization.

prompt_source: Nomor komponen berbeda dari kartu kerja. Apa tindakan tepat?
prompt_english: The component number differs from the work card. What should you do?
explanation_source: Perbedaan dokumen harus diselesaikan sebelum pekerjaan diteruskan.
explanation_english: Resolve document discrepancies before continuing the work.

prompt_source: Dalam alur «Kartu kerja dan keterlacakan perawatan», setelah langkah pertama selesai, apa langkah berikutnya?
prompt_english: In the “Work card and maintenance traceability” workflow, what is the next step after the first one?
explanation_source: Urutan yang diajarkan: Cocokkan identitas pesawat dan nomor tugas → Pastikan instruksi berlaku dan terbaca → Lakukan hanya langkah dalam otorisasi → Catat hasil dan serahkan untuk verifikasi.
explanation_english: Sequence taught: Match the aircraft identification and job number → Confirm the instructions are current and legible → Perform only the steps you are authorized to do → Record the results and submit them for verification.

prompt_source: Apa tindakan jika komponen kecil yang digunakan hilang?
prompt_english: What should you do if a small component being used goes missing?
explanation_source: Benda asing tertinggal dapat membahayakan pesawat dan harus ditelusuri.
explanation_english: A foreign object left behind can endanger the aircraft and must be located.

prompt_source: Sekrup jatuh dan belum ditemukan. Apa tindakan tepat?
prompt_english: A screw has fallen and has not been found. What should you do?
explanation_source: Komponen hilang perlu dikendalikan dan dicari sebelum pekerjaan diteruskan.
explanation_english: Control and locate missing components before continuing the work.

prompt_source: Dalam alur «Pengencangan dan pengukuran mekanis», setelah langkah pertama selesai, apa langkah berikutnya?
prompt_english: In the “Fastening and mechanical measurement” workflow, what is the next step after the first one?
explanation_source: Urutan yang diajarkan: Baca metode dan batas pada instruksi kerja → Siapkan alat serta hitung kelengkapannya → Kerjakan sesuai urutan, nilai, dan teknik → Catat hasil dan laporkan masalah.
explanation_english: Sequence taught: Read the methods and limits in the work instructions → Prepare the tools and count them → Work according to the specified sequence, values, and techniques → Record results and report problems.

lesson_title_source: Pengukuran listrik dan serah terima anomali
prompt_source: Apa yang dilakukan dengan hasil pengukuran listrik yang tidak normal?
prompt_english: What should be done with an abnormal electrical measurement?
explanation_source: Hasil harus dicatat faktual dan dinilai personel berwenang.
explanation_english: Record results factually and have authorized personnel assess them.

lesson_title_source: Pengukuran listrik dan serah terima anomali
prompt_source: Nilai tidak stabil dan ada bau terbakar. Apa tindakan tepat?
prompt_english: The reading is unstable, and there is a burning smell. What should you do?
explanation_source: Bau terbakar adalah tanda bahaya yang harus diamankan dan diperiksa.
explanation_english: A burning smell is a hazard that must be made safe and investigated.

lesson_title_source: Pengukuran listrik dan serah terima anomali
prompt_source: Dalam alur «Pengukuran listrik dan serah terima anomali», setelah langkah pertama selesai, apa langkah berikutnya?
prompt_english: In the “Electrical measurement and anomaly handover” workflow, what is the next step after the first one?
explanation_source: Urutan yang diajarkan: Cocokkan rangkaian dan titik ukur dengan kartu kerja → Pastikan alat, kondisi aman, dan otorisasi → Catat hasil dan tanda tidak normal → Hentikan serta laporkan kepada teknisi berwenang.
explanation_english: Sequence taught: Match the circuit and measurement points to the work card → Confirm the tool, safe conditions, and authorization → Record the results and any abnormal signs → Stop and report the issue to an authorized technician.

prompt_source: Standar hasil kerja sebaiknya ditentukan dari apa?
prompt_english: What should determine the work standards?
explanation_source: Standar meliputi kebersihan, keamanan, kondisi permukaan, serta kontrak pekerjaan.
explanation_english: Standards cover cleanliness, safety, surface condition, and the service contract.

lesson_title_english: Daily and Periodic Cleaning and Inspection
prompt_source: Pencucian berkala tidak dapat dilakukan saat ruang dipakai. Apa yang dilakukan?
prompt_english: Periodic washing cannot be done while the room is in use. What should you do?
explanation_source: Catatan penundaan menjaga keterlacakan dan keselamatan pengguna.
explanation_english: A record of the delay supports traceability and user safety.

lesson_title_english: Daily and Periodic Cleaning and Inspection
prompt_source: Pembersihan harian terutama menangani apa?
prompt_english: What does daily cleaning mainly address?
explanation_source: Pekerjaan harian berbeda dari pemeliharaan berkala dan perbaikan teknis.
explanation_english: Daily cleaning differs from periodic maintenance and technical repairs.

prompt_source: Dompet temuan harus bagaimana?
prompt_english: What should you do with a lost wallet?
explanation_source: Pencatatan dan penyerahan resmi melindungi pemilik serta petugas.
explanation_english: Recording and formally handing in the wallet protects both its owner and staff.

prompt_source: Kapan rambu lantai basah boleh dipindahkan?
prompt_english: When may a wet-floor sign be removed?
explanation_source: Pembukaan area berdasarkan kondisi nyata, bukan waktu perkiraan saja.
explanation_english: Reopen the area based on its actual condition, not on an estimated time alone.

prompt_source: Jalur evakuasi harus bagaimana saat pembersihan?
prompt_english: What condition must evacuation routes be kept in during cleaning?
explanation_source: Jalur evakuasi tidak boleh dihalangi oleh alat atau pembatas.
explanation_english: Do not block evacuation routes with equipment or barriers.

prompt_source: Cara mengurangi risiko saat beban terlalu berat?
prompt_english: How can you reduce risk when a load is too heavy?
explanation_source: Alat bantu dan pembagian beban lebih aman daripada memaksakan postur.
explanation_english: Using equipment and sharing a load is safer than forcing an awkward posture.

lesson_title_source: Insiden, bahan tumpah, dan keadaan darurat
prompt_source: Bahan tanpa label tumpah. Tindakan awal?
prompt_english: An unlabeled substance has spilled. What should you do first?
explanation_source: Bahan tak dikenal tidak boleh diuji sendiri atau dicampur.
explanation_english: Do not test or mix an unknown substance yourself.

lesson_title_source: Insiden, bahan tumpah, dan keadaan darurat
prompt_source: Apa isi laporan insiden yang berguna?
prompt_english: What information makes an incident report useful?
explanation_source: Laporan faktual membantu respons dan pencegahan kejadian berulang.
explanation_english: A factual report supports the response and helps prevent similar incidents.

module_title_source: Kotoran, bahan permukaan, dan bahan kimia
prompt_source: Mengapa debu dan pasir diangkat sebelum menggosok?
prompt_english: Why should dust and sand be removed before scrubbing?
explanation_source: Partikel kasar dapat menggores ketika tertarik alat pembersih.
explanation_english: A cleaning tool can drag coarse particles across the surface and scratch it.

module_title_source: Kotoran, bahan permukaan, dan bahan kimia
lesson_title_english: Product Labels, SDS, and Chemical Storage
prompt_source: Wadah bahan kimia yang benar?
prompt_english: What is the correct container for a chemical?
explanation_source: Identitas dan wadah sesuai mencegah paparan serta salah penggunaan.
explanation_english: Correct identification and containers prevent exposure and misuse.

module_title_source: Kotoran, bahan permukaan, dan bahan kimia
lesson_title_english: Product Labels, SDS, and Chemical Storage
prompt_source: Pemutih berklorin boleh dicampur pembersih asam?
prompt_english: Can chlorine bleach be mixed with an acidic cleaner?
explanation_source: Campuran kimia yang tidak kompatibel berbahaya; ikuti label produk.
explanation_english: Incompatible chemical mixtures are dangerous; follow the product label.

module_title_source: Kotoran, bahan permukaan, dan bahan kimia
prompt_source: Waktu kontak disinfektan ditentukan oleh apa?
prompt_english: What determines the contact time for a disinfectant?

explanation_english: Keeping tools separate prevents cross-contamination between zones.

explanation_english: Drying and storage help keep tools hygienic.

explanation_source: Isolasi daya diperlukan untuk pemeriksaan dan perawatan aman.
explanation_english: Disconnect power before safely inspecting or servicing the machine.

prompt_english: A cable is frayed, but the machine still works. What should you do?
explanation_source: Fungsi motor tidak membuktikan keamanan kabel listrik.
explanation_english: A working motor does not prove that its electrical cable is safe.

prompt_english: What should guide the choice of machine accessories?
explanation_source: Kompatibilitas pad/sikat dan material menentukan metode yang aman.
explanation_english: Pad/brush compatibility and the surface material determine the safe method.

lesson_title_english: Removing Dust and Mopping Hard Floors
prompt_source: Air berlebih pada lantai peka air dapat apa?
prompt_english: What can excess water do to a water-sensitive floor?
explanation_source: Volume air disesuaikan material dan metode, bukan sebanyak mungkin.
explanation_english: Use an amount of water suited to the material and method, not as much as possible.

prompt_source: Semua lantai harus diberi wax?
prompt_english: Should every floor be waxed?
explanation_source: Lapisan pelindung harus cocok dengan sistem lantai.
explanation_english: Protective finishes must be compatible with the floor system.

prompt_english: What is important before applying a floor finish?
explanation_source: Residu dan kelembapan dapat mengganggu hasil serta keselamatan.
explanation_english: Residue and moisture can affect the result and safety.

prompt_source: Karpet lembap setelah perawatan boleh langsung dibuka?
prompt_english: Can a carpet be reopened immediately after treatment while it is still damp?
explanation_source: Kelembapan dan keselamatan area harus diperiksa sebelum akses dibuka.
explanation_english: Check moisture and area safety before allowing access.

prompt_source: Alat kloset dipakai ke wastafel. Apa masalahnya?
prompt_english: A toilet-cleaning tool is used on a sink. What is the problem?
explanation_source: Alat harus dipisah menurut zona dan jenis tugas.
explanation_english: Keep tools separate according to zone and task type.

prompt_source: Sebelum masuk toilet untuk membersihkan?
prompt_english: What should be done before entering a restroom to clean it?
explanation_source: Keselamatan dan privasi pengguna diperiksa sebelum pekerjaan.
explanation_english: Check user safety and privacy before beginning the work.

prompt_source: Titik sentuh dibersihkan memakai apa?
prompt_english: What should be used to clean touchpoints?
explanation_source: Pemisahan alat mencegah perpindahan kontaminasi ke titik sentuh.
explanation_english: Keeping tools separate prevents transferring contamination to touchpoints.

prompt_source: Sabun berbeda jenis boleh langsung dicampur?
prompt_english: Can different types of soap be mixed directly?
explanation_source: Campuran dan pengisian yang salah dapat menyebabkan kontaminasi atau gangguan produk.
explanation_english: Incorrect mixing or refilling can cause contamination or product problems.

prompt_source: Apa yang diperiksa sebelum membuka toilet?
prompt_english: What should be checked before reopening a restroom?
explanation_source: Pemeriksaan menyeluruh memastikan fasilitas benar-benar siap digunakan.
explanation_english: A thorough inspection confirms the facility is ready for use.

prompt_source: Squeegee meninggalkan garis. Periksa apa?
prompt_english: A squeegee is leaving streaks. What should you check?
explanation_source: Karet kotor atau rusak mengganggu pengangkatan larutan dari kaca.
explanation_english: Dirty or damaged rubber prevents the squeegee from removing solution cleanly from glass.

prompt_source: Cara membersihkan panel tombol elektronik?
prompt_english: How should an electronic button panel be cleaned?
explanation_source: Celah perangkat harus dilindungi dari cairan.
explanation_english: Protect openings in the device from liquids.

prompt_source: Stainless steel tahan semua bahan kimia?
prompt_english: Is stainless steel resistant to all chemicals?
explanation_source: Lapisan dan finishing dapat rusak oleh produk atau gesekan yang salah.
explanation_english: The coating and finish can be damaged by the wrong product or excessive friction.

prompt_source: Kerusakan tepi tangga ditemukan. Apa tindakan tepat?
prompt_english: Damage is found on the edge of a stair. What should you do?
explanation_source: Penandaan dan laporan memungkinkan penanganan teknis yang sesuai.
explanation_english: Marking and reporting the damage allows the proper technical response.

prompt_source: Bolehkah menekan sampah dalam kantong dengan tangan?
prompt_english: May you press down trash in a bag by hand?
explanation_source: Sarung tangan tidak menghilangkan risiko tusukan dari isi tak terlihat.
explanation_english: Gloves do not eliminate the risk of puncture from hidden contents.

prompt_source: Aturan pemilahan sampah mengacu pada apa?
prompt_english: What should waste-sorting rules be based on?
explanation_source: Kategori dan jalur pembuangan bergantung ketentuan lokasi.
explanation_english: Waste categories and disposal routes depend on local requirements.

prompt_source: Terkena tusukan saat kerja. Apa yang dilakukan?
prompt_english: You are punctured by something during work. What should you do?
explanation_source: Penanganan paparan perlu cepat sesuai protokol fasilitas.
explanation_english: Respond promptly to an exposure according to facility protocol.

prompt_english: What should you do after removing gloves used for a dirty task?
explanation_source: Tangan dapat terkontaminasi selama pelepasan sarung tangan.
explanation_english: Hands can become contaminated while removing gloves.

lesson_title_source: Kebersihan tangan dan disinfeksi yang tepat

prompt_english: Does disinfection replace removing dirt?
explanation_source: Kotoran dapat mengganggu efektivitas proses disinfeksi.
explanation_english: Dirt can reduce the effectiveness of disinfection.

lesson_title_english: Reading Instructions and Planning the Sequence
prompt_source: Prinsip umum urutan pembersihan?
prompt_english: What is the general principle for the order of cleaning?
explanation_source: Urutan terencana mengurangi pengotoran kembali area yang sudah bersih.
explanation_english: A planned order reduces the chance of soiling areas that have already been cleaned.

prompt_source: Kerusakan ditemukan setelah kerja. Apa tindakan tepat?
prompt_english: Damage is found after the work. What should you do?
explanation_source: Pelaporan faktual memungkinkan penilaian dan penanganan yang tepat.
explanation_english: Factual reporting allows the issue to be assessed and handled appropriately.

prompt_source: Keluhan pengguna ditanggapi dengan apa?
prompt_english: How should a user's complaint be handled?
explanation_source: Komunikasi netral membantu penyelesaian tanpa janji di luar kewenangan.
explanation_english: Neutral communication helps resolve complaints without making promises beyond your authority.

lesson_title_source: Penggunaan sumber daya dan serah terima shift
prompt_source: Cara menghemat bahan dengan aman?
prompt_english: How can materials be used economically and safely?
explanation_source: Efisiensi tidak boleh mengubah syarat efektivitas dan keselamatan.
explanation_english: Efficiency must not change effectiveness or safety requirements.

explanation_source: Pengendalian akses dilakukan sebelum bahaya diciptakan dan diakhiri setelah inspeksi.
explanation_english: Control access before creating a hazard, and end the restriction only after inspection.

prompt_source: Simulasi teks membuktikan kemampuan mengoperasikan mesin?
prompt_english: Does a text simulation prove the ability to operate a machine?
explanation_source: Pengambilan keputusan tertulis tidak menggantikan keterampilan praktik nyata.
explanation_english: A written decision-making exercise does not replace practical skills.

prompt_source: Anda dipindahkan ke pekerjaan utilitas tanpa gambar atau pengarahan. Apa tindakan tepat?
prompt_english: You are moved to utility work without drawings or a briefing. What should you do?
explanation_source: Perbedaan lokasi/proyek mengubah gambar dan kondisi; pekerjaan belum jelas harus diklarifikasi.
explanation_english: Drawings and conditions vary by site and project; clarify any work that is not clear.

explanation_source: Briefing menyatukan pemahaman tim dengan rencana dan risiko yang relevan.
explanation_english: A briefing aligns the team's understanding with the relevant plan and risks.

lesson_title_source: Rencana kerja harian dan komunikasi bahaya
lesson_title_english: Daily Work Plans and Hazard Communication
prompt_source: Jalur kendaraan berubah dan bersinggungan dengan area kerja setelah briefing. Apa yang dilakukan?
prompt_english: The vehicle route changes and crosses the work area after the briefing. What should you do?
explanation_source: Perubahan kondisi memerlukan penilaian ulang dan komunikasi sebelum tugas terdampak diteruskan.
explanation_english: Changed conditions require reassessment and communication before affected work resumes.

lesson_title_source: Rencana kerja harian dan komunikasi bahaya
lesson_title_english: Daily Work Plans and Hazard Communication
prompt_source: Apa arti 「作業計画（さぎょうけいかく）」 dalam konteks konstruksi?
prompt_english: What does 「作業計画（さぎょうけいかく）」 mean in the context of construction?
explanation_source: 「作業計画」dibaca さぎょうけいかく dan berarti rencana kerja.
explanation_english: 「作業計画」is read さぎょうけいかく and means work plan.

prompt_source: Fungsi pembatas area adalah…
prompt_english: The purpose of an area barrier is to…
explanation_source: Pembatas dan tanda memberi kendali akses; kondisinya harus dijaga.
explanation_english: Barriers and signs control access; they must be kept in proper condition.

prompt_source: Pembatas di dekat lubang bergeser ke jalur pejalan kaki. Apa respons tepat?
prompt_english: A barrier near an opening has shifted into a pedestrian route. What is the appropriate response?
explanation_source: Jaga diri dan hentikan paparan; perbaikan mengikuti rencana dan komunikasi lokasi.
explanation_english: Protect yourself and stop exposure; correct the issue according to the site plan and communication procedures.

prompt_source: Sebelum membuat penandaan dari gambar, pastikan…
prompt_english: Before marking out from a drawing, make sure…
explanation_source: Informasi terkendali harus konsisten dengan kondisi dan dokumen yang disetujui.
explanation_english: Controlled information must agree with site conditions and approved documents.

prompt_source: Dokumen di lapangan menunjukkan revisi berbeda. Bagaimana bertindak?
prompt_english: The document at the worksite shows a different revision. What should you do?
explanation_source: Revisi perlu dikendalikan sebelum pekerjaan yang bergantung padanya berjalan.
explanation_english: Revisions must be controlled before dependent work proceeds.

prompt_source: Apa arti 「図面（ずめん）」 dalam konteks konstruksi?
prompt_english: What does 「図面（ずめん）」 mean in the context of construction?
explanation_source: 「図面」dibaca ずめん dan berarti gambar teknik.
explanation_english: 「図面」is read ずめん and means a technical drawing.

prompt_source: Dua hasil elevasi berbeda. Apa langkah berikutnya?
prompt_english: Two elevation readings differ. What is the next step?
explanation_source: Ketidaksesuaian harus diperiksa pada sumber referensi sebelum menetapkan posisi.
explanation_english: Check the reference source for discrepancies before setting a position.

prompt_source: Apa arti 「測量（そくりょう）」 dalam konteks konstruksi?
prompt_english: What does 「測量（そくりょう）」 mean in the context of construction?
explanation_source: 「測量」dibaca そくりょう dan berarti survei/pengukuran.
explanation_english: 「測量」is read そくりょう and means surveying/measurement.

prompt_source: Pemeriksaan penerimaan berguna untuk memastikan…
prompt_english: An acceptance inspection is useful for verifying…
explanation_source: Pemeriksaan menjaga kesesuaian dan mencegah material tidak sesuai terpasang.
explanation_english: Inspection confirms conformity and prevents unsuitable materials from being installed.

prompt_source: Material tidak memiliki identitas lot yang diwajibkan. Apa tindakan tepat?
prompt_english: Material is missing the required lot identification. What should you do?
explanation_source: Keterlacakan perlu dipastikan sebelum material digunakan.
explanation_english: Traceability must be confirmed before the material is used.

prompt_source: Apa arti 「資材（しざい）」 dalam konteks konstruksi?
prompt_english: What does 「資材（しざい）」 mean in the context of construction?
explanation_source: 「資材」dibaca しざい dan berarti material konstruksi.
explanation_english: 「資材」is read しざい and means construction materials.

prompt_source: Saat kondisi utilitas atau tanah menyimpang dari rencana, pekerja harus…
prompt_english: When utility or ground conditions differ from the plan, workers must…
explanation_source: Penyimpangan dapat menimbulkan bahaya serius dan perlu ditangani terkoordinasi.
explanation_english: Deviations can create serious hazards and must be handled in a coordinated way.

prompt_source: Posisi utilitas di lapangan berbeda dengan tanda rencana. Apa tindakan aman?
prompt_english: The utility's position on site differs from the mark on the plan. What is the safe action?
explanation_source: Jangan mendekati atau mengubah utilitas yang belum diketahui.
explanation_english: Do not approach or alter an unidentified utility.

prompt_source: Mengapa pemeriksaan sebelum bagian tertutup atau pengecoran penting?
prompt_english: Why is an inspection before a section is covered or concrete is poured important?
explanation_source: Tahapan pemeriksaan harus terjadi pada titik yang ditetapkan sebelum akses visual hilang.
explanation_english: Required inspections must take place at the designated hold point before visual access is lost.

prompt_source: Dukungan bekisting bergeser sebelum pengecoran. Apa tindakan tepat?
prompt_english: Formwork support shifts before concrete is poured. What should you do?
explanation_source: Dukungan sementara harus dinilai dan diperbaiki oleh pihak berwenang sebelum beban diterapkan.
explanation_english: Temporary supports must be assessed and corrected by authorized personnel before a load is applied.

prompt_source: Apa arti 「型枠（かたわく）」 dalam konteks konstruksi?
prompt_english: What does 「型枠（かたわく）」 mean in the context of construction?
explanation_source: 「型枠」dibaca かたわく dan berarti bekisting.
explanation_english: 「型枠」is read かたわく and means formwork.

prompt_source: Pipa tanpa identitas akan dipotong sesuai tugas. Apa respons aman?
prompt_english: A pipe without identification is scheduled to be cut. What is the safe response?
explanation_source: Identitas dan keadaan energi/tekanan harus dipastikan sebelum intervensi.
explanation_english: Confirm the identity and energy or pressure state before intervening.

prompt_source: Apa arti 「配管（はいかん）」 dalam konteks konstruksi?
prompt_english: What does 「配管（はいかん）」 mean in the context of construction?
explanation_source: 「配管」dibaca はいかん dan berarti pemipaan.
explanation_english: 「配管」is read はいかん and means piping.

prompt_source: Jika hasil lapangan berbeda dari spesifikasi, pekerja sebaiknya…
prompt_english: If site results differ from the specifications, workers should…
explanation_source: Deviasi memerlukan evaluasi dan keputusan sebelum tahap lanjutan.
explanation_english: A deviation must be evaluated and a decision made before the next stage proceeds.

prompt_source: Sambungan akan tertutup sebelum titik inspeksi diwajibkan. Apa tindakan tepat?
prompt_english: A connection is about to be covered before the required inspection point. What should you do?
explanation_source: Titik inspeksi harus diselesaikan ketika bagian masih dapat diperiksa.
explanation_english: The inspection point must be completed while the section can still be inspected.

prompt_source: Apa arti 「施工（せこう）」 dalam konteks konstruksi?
prompt_english: What does 「施工（せこう）」 mean in the context of construction?
explanation_source: 「施工」dibaca せこう dan berarti pelaksanaan konstruksi.
explanation_english: 「施工」is read せこう and means construction work.

lesson_title_english: Environmental Protection and Waste Material Management
prompt_source: Material sisa yang tak diketahui harus…
prompt_english: Unidentified leftover material must…
explanation_source: Klasifikasi dan penanganan harus sesuai aturan; jangan menebak sifat bahan.
explanation_english: Classification and handling must follow the rules; do not guess the material's properties.

lesson_title_english: Environmental Protection and Waste Material Management
prompt_source: Wadah tak berlabel ada dekat saluran hujan. Apa tindakan terbaik?
prompt_english: An unlabeled container is near a storm drain. What is the best action?
explanation_source: Bahan tidak dikenal tidak boleh dipindah atau dibuang tanpa penilaian dan kewenangan.
explanation_english: Do not move or dispose of an unidentified substance without assessment and authorization.

prompt_source: Catatan pekerjaan yang baik terutama harus…
prompt_english: A good work record should primarily be…
explanation_source: Catatan yang terhubung dengan lokasi dan dokumen mendukung koordinasi dan pemeriksaan.
explanation_english: Records linked to locations and documents support coordination and inspection.

prompt_source: Area masih dibatasi saat shift berakhir. Apa langkah tepat?
prompt_english: The area is still restricted when the shift ends. What is the proper step?
explanation_source: Status dan batas area perlu diteruskan supaya shift berikutnya tetap aman.
explanation_english: Pass on the status and area restrictions to keep the next shift safe.

prompt_source: Apa arti 「日報（にっぽう）」 dalam konteks konstruksi?
prompt_english: What does 「日報（にっぽう）」 mean in the context of construction?
explanation_source: 「日報」dibaca にっぽう dan berarti laporan harian.
explanation_english: 「日報」is read にっぽう and means a daily report.

prompt_english: Scenario: A caught organism's protected status is unknown. The most appropriate action is to…
explanation_source: Konfirmasikan identitas dan prosedur kepada penanggung jawab. Status hasil tangkap bergantung ketentuan yang berlaku, bukan keberadaannya di alat saja.
explanation_english: Confirm the organism's identity and the procedure with the person in charge. Whether a catch may be kept depends on applicable rules, not merely on its presence in the gear.

explanation_source: 禁漁 dibaca きんりょう dan berarti larangan penangkapan. Kenali istilah ini sebelum mengikuti instruksi kerja.
explanation_english: 禁漁 is read きんりょう and means a fishing ban. Learn this term before following work instructions.

module_title_english: Capture Fisheries · Foundations and Operating Environment
lesson_title_source: Sumber daya, hasil samping, dan aturan tangkap
